title: Marvell Lands ‘White Whale’ Google, Raises Stakes Ahead Of Q2 Report: Analyst Says TPU Deal ‘Greatly Expands’ MRVL’s Long-Term AI Opportunity
title_zh: Marvell 收购“白鲸”谷歌，在第二季度报告发布前增持股份：分析师称 TPU 交易“极大扩展”了 MRVL 的长期人工智能机会
summary: Morningstar said the long-term opportunity far outweighs share-dilution concerns.
summary_zh: 晨星表示，长期机遇远远超过了股票稀释的担忧。

title: Preferreds Offer 6.5% Yields or More After Bond Market Selloff
title_zh: 债券市场抛售后优先股收益率达 6.5% 或更高
summary: Credit quality is strong in part because banks, the largest issuers, have rarely been in better shape over the past few decades.
summary_zh: 信贷质量之所以强劲，部分原因在于作为最大发行人的银行在过去几十年里的状况很少见。

title: Nebius Increases Debt Raise Plan To $5B: Neocloud Operator Reportedly Bids For Decart AI Buyout Eyed by Anthropic

summary: Nebius just announced its third major debt issue in a year to support its massive AI infrastructure expansion.
summary_zh: Nebius 刚刚宣布了一年内的第三次重大债务发行，以支持其大规模的人工智能基础设施扩张。

title: Stock Market Today, Aug. 19: Nebius Falls 10% on $4.5 Billion Convertible Note Offering
title_zh: 今日股市，8 月 19 日：Nebius 发行 45 亿美元可转换票据，股价下跌 10%
summary: On Aug. 19, 2026, the AI cloud provider announced a massive debt-to-equity conversion plan, triggering dilution concerns and heavy selling pressure.
summary_zh: 2026年8月19日，这家人工智能云提供商宣布了大规模债转股计划，引发稀释担忧和沉重的抛售压力。
